en.headline: CUHK president seeks larger loan for Northern Metropolis campus
en.dek: Dennis Lo Yuk-ming told RTHK he hopes the HK$10 billion construction loan reserved for universities in the Northern Metropolis can be increased so the university can plan a larger Hung Shui Kiu campus.
body: The vice-chancellor of the Chinese University of Hong Kong, Dennis Lo Yuk-ming, said he hopes the government will enlarge the HK$10 billion loan set aside for universities building campuses in the Northern Metropolis, so CUHK can plan a bigger expansion at Hung Shui Kiu.

Speaking on RTHK’s television programme Guest Room, Lo said CUHK’s rankings and reputation had improved but its scale remained limited. He described Hung Shui Kiu as well placed and said the Northern Metropolis could help the university grow. He added that CUHK is working to establish a tenth college and more student hostels to attract stronger applicants.

Lo said 150 new professors had joined CUHK over the past three years and that 56 per cent of academic staff were recruited from outside Hong Kong. He said the university had stepped up recruitment in the Middle East, Southeast Asia and Belt and Road countries, with international applications this year 75 per cent higher than previously, which he said showed Hong Kong’s draw.

Asked what kind of vice-chancellor he hoped to be more than a year into the post, Lo said he would be content if, by the time he stepped down, he had planted seeds for work that later proved distinctive for CUHK and of wider significance.

zh.headline: 中大校長盧煌明冀北都建校百億貸款加碼
zh.dek: 盧煌明接受港台訪問，指北部都會區洪水橋位置優越，希望政府將預留予院校的100億元建設貸款加碼，方便中大規劃擴展。
body: 中文大學校長盧煌明表示，正籌建第十間書院及增加學生宿位，並希望政府就北部都會區大學城發展，將預留予院校建設的100億元貸款加碼，讓中大更容易規劃在洪水橋的擴展。
他接受港台電視節目《廣播道會客室》訪問時說，中大近年排名及聲譽有進步，但規模仍然不夠大。他認為洪水橋位置優越，北都可以協助中大擴展。
盧煌明指，過去三年有150名新教授加入中大，教師國際化比例達56%。中大亦在中東、東南亞及一帶一路地區招生，今年國際學生申請較以往增加75%，他認為這反映香港的吸引力。
上任一年多，被問及希望成為怎樣的校長，他說若任內能為一些對中大具標誌性、甚至影響更廣的發展播下種子，日後回望會感到安慰。
